titulo: Verbs of position and the N-declension: Stehen × stellen, liegen × legen

aula.titulo: Verbs of position and the N-declension
aula.objetivo: Use the position verbs (stehen/stellen, liegen/legen, sitzen/setzen, hängen) with Wo? and Wohin?, and the N-declension of weak masculine nouns (der Student → den Studenten).

itens.pt: to stand (something) up, to put upright
to lay, to put down flat

blocos.titulo: Stehen × stellen and liegen × legen, step by step
blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: German has TWO verbs for each position: one says WHERE something IS (a state, Wo?) and the other says you PUT something there (movement, Wohin?). English has the same pair with lie/lay and sit/set — German just does it for "stand" too. STEP 2: stehen (to be standing) × stellen (to put something upright). STEP 3: liegen (to be lying) × legen (to lay something down) — exactly like English lie × lay. STEP 4: the STATE verb takes the DATIVE, the MOVEMENT verb takes the ACCUSATIVE: «Die Vase steht auf dem Tisch» (the vase is on the table) × «Ich stelle die Vase auf den Tisch» (I put the vase on the table). STEP 5: the forms: stehen – stand – gestanden; stellen – stellte – gestellt; liegen – lag – gelegen; legen – legte – gelegt. Note the pattern: the state verbs are strong, the "putting" verbs are regular. STEP 6: tall things or things that stand upright (bottle, vase, lamp, chair) use stehen/stellen; flat things or things lying down (book, newspaper, key) use liegen/legen.
blocos.comparacao: English mostly says "is" and "put" for everything: "the book is on the table", "I put the vase on the table". German asks first: is it standing or lying? That choice picks the verb pair. Your best anchor is English lie/lay and sit/set — the same old Germanic pairs.

tabela.exemplo: Die Lampe steht neben dem Sofa. / Ich stelle die Lampe neben das Sofa.
Das Buch liegt auf dem Tisch. / Ich lege das Buch auf den Tisch.

erros.errado: Ich stehe die Vase auf den Tisch.
erros.certo: Ich stelle die Vase auf den Tisch.

erros.errado: Das Buch legt auf dem Tisch.
erros.certo: Das Buch liegt auf dem Tisch.

blocos.enunciado: Describe 4 objects: where they are (steht / liegt) and where you put them (stelle / lege).
Write the nine two-way prepositions and the golden rule.
